meta.title: x/tools/gopls: modernize slices.Clone suggestion wrong when copying between aliased types
meta.build_notes: Both built and run with go1.24.4 (golang.org/dl, under temp/lsp_servers/go-sdks; toolchain.json): the local go1.27 cannot build v0.18.1, go1.24.0 (current when v0.18.1 was tagged, 2025-02-24) cannot build v0.19.0 (its go.mod requires go >= 1.24.2), and go1.24.4 was the current Go release when v0.19.0 was tagged (2025-06-10). The reporter used gopls v0.18.1; the fix merged 2025-06-02.
meta.notes: The appendclipped pass rewrote append([]string{}, a...) to slices.Clone(a), whose result has a's named type ssa instead of []string, so the assignment to a variable of type ssb no longer type-checks. The fix offers no rewrite when a slice argument's type differs from the base's type.

settings_note: The modernize analyzer is on by default in both builds; the reporter ran the modernize command at the same analyzer.

files.source: issue body, 'What did you do?' code block

files.note: a module around the file (the issue gives no go.mod); go 1.24, the Go of the era (slices modernizers need go1.21)

repro.steps: Open main.go. The appendclipped pass reports 'var b ssb = append([]string{}, a...)' ('Replace append with slices.Clone'). Apply its fix. Reported: 'var b ssb = slices.Clone(a)' fails with 'cannot use slices.Clone(a) (value of slice type ssa) as ssb value in variable declaration'. Probe: a fresh session on the edited text must report no error the original did not have; no fix offered means absent (the fix stops offering it).
